resolution: Fixed the iso build pane's per-frame ~970ms PLACEFREEZE visualBoxes stall at 785 pieces. Root cause was two compounding O(N²) scans per render: (1) the wall join/depth-span questions in placed.ts scanned the entire piece array for EVERY piece (wallJoinRunLimits + placedPieceDepthSpan, with depthSpan re-scanned per matched candidate), and (2) liftBuildingsToTerrain's loose-piece union-find bounds-tested every pair. Replaced both with spatial-grid candidate narrowing: a footprint grid built once per distinct pieces array (WeakMap-cached on array identity) feeds depthSpan/run-limits/smart-select; the lift buckets loose pieces into a spatial hash and only tests cell-sharing pairs. Exact predicates unchanged → identical behavior (placed.test.ts 46/46, rjit game verify GREEN 71/71). Also keyed IsoAuthor's worldGrid memo on world fields instead of state so a state-identity tick can't cascade into a full lift+re-render every frame. Bench at 786 pieces: bands-for-all-pieces 4ms cold/~1ms warm, lift ~1ms (was ~970ms). User confirmed resolved live in the editor.
